description: A failure and its fix; the file and commit are shown in the events and must be kept.

events.text: The spool import loses events when the process is killed halfway.
Reproduced: kill -9 during 'chloe events import' deleted spool files before the transaction committed.
crates/chloe-cli/src/events.rs: delete a queue file only after the commit that stores its event. Committed as 4d350c4.
Good. Always delete queue files after the commit, never before.

candidates.title: Delete spool files only after the commit that stores their events
candidates.content: Deleting before the commit loses events when the importer is killed. Re-importing after a crash is safe because events are idempotent.

candidates.title: A killed import must not lose events
